variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: visual development reference for a WebGPU gummy chess game, an aspirational concept render (not a screenshot). Generate a premium photoreal 3D confectionery product photograph of six readable chess pieces: pawn, rook, knight, bishop, queen, king. All six standing fully in frame, well separated in an elegant shallow arc, simple warm peach studio surface, three-quarter eye-level close product photography. Material must look like thick, solid, saturated translucent gummy candy with a wet molded surface, broad warm studio reflections, soft internal light and colored caustics. It must have real visual weight, chunky proportions and pleasantly swollen curves, like a big bulky gummy bear; avoid hollow glass, acrylic, foggy milky plastic, metallic ornament, thin fragile details, tiny internal copies, spikes, filigree, faceting, and complicated environment. Different colors may be poured in horizontal layers through each solid piece, blending very slightly at the boundary. Every piece should be plausible as a single continuous volumetric soft-body mesh, with no disconnected accessories. No board, no hands, no text, no logos, no watermark. Excellent detailed, physically plausible lighting; still recognizable at thumbnail size. Direction A: BEAR COURT. Each piece is an adorable stout gummy bear reinterpreted as chess royalty, with plump belly, broad paws, big thick ears, short thick neck, molded subtle eyes and muzzle. Integrate each role into the molded head: pawn plain round bear head; rook broad rounded castle crenellations fused between ears; knight a softly swept horse-like mane profile fused to bear head; bishop a single rounded mitre and shallow diagonal groove; queen five broad rounded crown lobes; king a chunky rounded cross seamlessly fused to crown. Do not just balance hats on ordinary bears. Deep cherry / wine colored upper heads, pink lower heads, emerald green chest, golden amber feet, following the four-band candy bear reference aesthetic. Each role has a clear distinct silhouette. Wider than typical slender chess pieces; joyful collectible candy sculptures. Landscape composition.
